f9f591c7139b1a46232d5e944469f2579542d648.summary: Hybrid Analysis sandbox page for an unnamed Windows sample (hash prefix 5d631d774016…) with a score of 100/100 and a malicious rating of 100%. Static analysis and ML by CrowdStrike flagged it with relatively high confidence, and many antivirus engines flagged it. Listed behaviours include a YARA match, unusual PE entropy, registry key monitoring, reads of terminal service keys, process hooking and suspicious API imports. No malware family, actor, CVE, sector or country is named.

techniques.q: Monitors specific registry key for changes
Reads terminal service related keys (often RDP related)
Contains ability to dynamically determine API calls
PE file has unusual entropy sections

hedges: Sample detected by CrowdStrike Static Analysis and ML with relatively high confidence

f9015ec340e025c16963e9b7cef4cbc3f4101ca7.summary: Group-IB report on JadeProx, a China-nexus cluster found through an exposed operator server in mid-April 2026. It describes the TriBack Loader (four variants, DLL sideloading) delivering AdaptixC2 and Beagle, phishing portals impersonating a Venezuelan municipal tax system and Claude-themed software, and intrusions in Vietnam, Malaysia, Hong Kong and Honduras. Attribution is to the China-nexus ecosystem without a single group, and several links to other groups are described as overlaps or consistent with.
